newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Feb seat load factor up 4.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Feb seat load factor up 4.8 pct.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG improved its group seat load factor by 4.8 percentage points to 68.8 percent in February, the airline's investor relations department said.

Group passenger numbers rose just 0.4 percent but this would have been an effective passenger increase of about four percent without the extra day in February 1996, the department's latest monthly traffic report showed.
Long-haul passenger numbers to destinations in the Americas rose 19.3 percent last month, the airline noted.
